Why Ottawa families choose BrightSmile

We built the dental practice we always wished existed: honest, gentle, and designed around your life — not the other way around.

Pain-free, judgment-free care

Nervous about the dentist? You're not alone. We explain everything before we do it, offer noise-cancelling headphones and weighted blankets, and never lecture you about flossing.

Upfront pricing, always

You approve a written estimate before any treatment starts. We bill most insurance plans directly, and flexible payment plans are available for implants and Invisalign.

Modern technology, shorter visits

Low-radiation digital X-rays, 3D implant planning and same-day crowns mean fewer appointments and less time in the chair.

Hours that fit real life

Early mornings, two evenings a week until 20:00, and Saturday appointments — because toothaches don't keep office hours, and neither do we.

Meet Dr. Sarah Mitchell

Founder & Lead Dentist, DDS

Dr. Mitchell has cared for Ottawa smiles for over 15 years. After graduating from the University of Toronto's Faculty of Dentistry, she completed advanced training in implantology and clear-aligner orthodontics — but what patients remember most is how she listens.

Her philosophy is simple: no rushed appointments, no unnecessary treatment, and no jargon. Whether it's your toddler's first visit or a full smile restoration, you'll always know your options, your costs, and why she recommends what she recommends.

Ask Us Anything

Frequently asked questions

Can't find your answer here? Message us on WhatsApp — a real person replies, not a bot.

Are you accepting new patients?
Yes — we welcome new patients of all ages, and we can usually offer a first appointment within the week. Your first visit includes a full exam, digital X-rays, a cleaning, and a personal treatment plan with clear pricing. There is never any pressure to book further treatment.
Do you accept my insurance?
We work with all major Canadian insurance providers — including Sun Life, Manulife, Canada Life and Green Shield — and we bill most plans directly so you don't have to chase paperwork. We'll check your coverage before treatment begins and tell you exactly what you'll pay out of pocket.
What should I do if I have a dental emergency?
Message us on WhatsApp right away — we hold same-day emergency slots every day we're open. For a knocked-out tooth, hold it by the crown (not the root), keep it moist in milk or in your cheek, and get to us within the hour for the best chance of saving it.
How much does Invisalign cost?
It depends on how much movement your teeth need — most of our cases fall between $3,800 and $6,500, with monthly payment plans available. Your consultation and 3D scan are free, and the quote we give you is fixed: no add-ons, no surprises partway through treatment.
I'm nervous about visiting the dentist. Can you help?
Absolutely — anxious patients are some of our favourites to win over. We go at your pace, agree on a stop signal before we start, and offer noise-cancelling headphones, weighted blankets and longer appointments so nothing ever feels rushed. Many of our most loyal patients arrived terrified.
Do you treat children?
Yes, we see children from their first tooth — usually around age one. Kids' visits are short and playful, focused on building positive habits early. We offer sealants, fluoride treatments and custom mouthguards for young athletes, and parents are always welcome in the room.

Ready for a smile you're proud of?

Your first step is a friendly conversation — no obligation, no pressure. Send us a message and let's talk about your smile.
